sections.title: Native package boundaries
sections.text: Preserve current names/runtime floors/autoload and barrels. Do not replace public APIs with RFC namespaces.

sections.title: Observed entries versus external consumers
sections.text: Local source entrypoints are observed; AiResto/ERP are unverified preservation obligations. Botkit is donor-only.

sections.title: Additive language projections
sections.text: Every logical schema has PHP/Dart applicability and adapter ownership; no generated SDK or provider support is claimed.

claims.statement: PHP production package remains agentools/sdk, AgenTools\ => src/, PHP >=8.3; reference/testkit/tests are dev autoload, not production imports. Reachability is not a stability promise.
Dart core remains agentools, SDK ^3.11.0, publish_to:none, public core barrel agentools.dart and separate testkit entry. MCP is optional private-paired and imports supported core only.

LlmPort.respond and ScenarioRunner remain current APIs. PHP supports IdempotencyKey or string run identity; Dart run retains IdempotencyKey and runWithId supplies string identity. Switching schemes changes keys; retries must retain the chosen persisted identity and scheme.
Independent AiResto/ERP/offline host bindings and deployment behavior are not inspected or live tested here; preservation is required even without an observed caller.
D1/D2/D3/D7 and owner-amendment-2026-10-31: one AgenTools platform, closed dated wire, external data owners, Botkit donor-only; no mandatory Botkit facade, data migration or rollout.

P1.2 records choice C separate transport, AgenTools sole future loop owner, no selected laravel/ai dependency and loop_proven:false. This is upstream design/offline evidence, not provider qualification.

decisions.decision: Keep dated 2026-09, namespace/package and PHP/Dart/offline direct Actions; platform v1 is additive.
decisions.rationale: Accepted execution-input D2 and observed package surface.

decisions.decision: Botkit is donor-only, no mandatory facade or data migration.
decisions.rationale: Owner amendment supersedes historical P1.1 migration recommendations; preserve actual AgenTools obligations.

limitations: Design/source matrix and focused tests only; no new runtime, durable dispatcher, host binding, provider live call or production readiness.
Independent AiResto/ERP callers are unverified, not absent; existing API obligations remain.
Raw plan schemas/examples are design samples, not an implementation or published protocol; conductor owns V1/V2/V3 and per-check receipts.
P1.4 must choose additive placement/dependencies from target evidence; P1.2 direct selection does not force laravel/ai or raise existing PHP SDK floor.
package_surface_scope: Exact selected boundary declarations, copied without tier promotion from the authoritative 386-entry manifest; not a new stability promise.

contract_provenance.method: Required contracts supplied inline in execution-input; execution-boundary and owner-amendment read through native Planner API. These provided hashes are not represented as a fresh raw-file hash computation.
contract_provenance.source_observation_scope: Listed current repository files and symbols only; historical inventory classifications do not imply implementation/live use.

preserve: ScenarioRunner legacy and string identity schemes
handoff_P1_4.future_ownership: Choose additive package names/paths and locks in P1.4; all platform projections here are planned and impose no new dependency on existing native SDKs.
handoff_P1_4.P1_2_input: Recorded separate direct transport, no laravel/ai target dependency, loop_proven:false; not live qualification.
gaps: Durable dispatcher must commit intent before IO; local EffectCommitter append is insufficient.
ConfirmationService.prepare currently creates fresh random proposal identity. Future stable proposal mapping must reuse saved result before re-entering prepare.
Dart existing LlmPort.respond is synchronous. Rich/async ModelTransport needs an explicit additive adapter; do not silently replace signature or co-execute a turn.
Existing idempotency retention/expiry is dated behavior. Platform long-lived identity registry is separate and must not silently alter SDK expiration.
Botkit migration/facade recommendations in historical P1.1 are not obligations. AiResto/ERP concrete bindings remain unverified.
